date.as_written: saṃvat 1860 sālamāghaśudi 5 roja 3 / śarāśvinagabhūśāke māghaśubhreṣu paṃcamī || gotrāpatye ca vāre

notes: The date is given both in VS 1860 (saṃvat 1860 sāla) and in Śāke chronogram (śara [5], aśvi [2], naga [7], bhū [1] = Śaka 1725), which corresponds to 1804 CE. 'gotrāpatye ca vāre' refers to Bhaumavāra / Tuesday (the son of the Earth). 'siṃhanāminā' could mean either a person named Siṃhanāmin or someone having 'Siṃha' in their name.
